title: UAAP: Alas puts on a show in crunch time as Ateneo pulls away from National U
summary: Kieffer Alas took over in crunch time as Ateneo de Manila University outlasted National University, 87-76, in UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball on Saturday at the PhilSports Arena in Pasig City.
